subject: Conditional ship-to coverage & split-billing: what documentation will clear invoices
messages:
From: Emily Huang <emily.h@acme.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Resale coverage for split billing + multiple ship-to locations

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this — quick question from procurement at Acme. We're onboarding Redwood for our new analytics credits, but setup is a bit unusual: billing will be split across two legal entities (Acme Holdings, EIN XX-XXXXXXX) and (Acme Ops LLC, EIN YY-YYYYYYY), while shipments (cloud seat assignment) will be delivered to two different ship-to locations (CA and TX).

We attached our existing blanket resale certificate for Acme Holdings (attached: acme_resale_cert_2026.pdf). For the split-billing flows, do you require:
- a separate resale certificate for Acme Ops LLC, or
- a signed delegation/POA from Acme Holdings stating it covers the second entity for tax-exempt purchases, or
- will a supplementary affidavit that lists the ship-to addresses + EIN suffice?

We prefer not to notarize if possible. Can you confirm acceptance criteria so we don't get invoices held? Also, is there a preferred upload portal or DocuSign workflow?

Appreciate a short checklist.

Best,
Emily Huang
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
[Attachment: acme_resale_cert_2026.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Huang <emily.h@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale coverage for split billing + multiple ship-to locations

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note and for sending the blanket certificate. Short answer: we can usually accept a supplementary affidavit that ties the ship-to addresses to the covered entity, but Texas (TX) has stricter requirements and often wants the seller to see a certificate that specifically references the billed entity or a delegated authorization.

A quick checklist from our side that will lift invoice holds once intake is validated:
- Certificate must include: legal entity name, EIN, signed date, and states claimed (your blanket looks good for CA).
- For split billing: either (A) a separate resale cert for Acme Ops LLC or (B) a delegation/letter on company letterhead (signed, dated) explicitly authorizing Acme Holdings to make exempt purchases on behalf of Acme Ops LLC.
- Supplementary affidavit that lists the ship-to addresses and states served (CA, TX) is acceptable for CA and WA; TX usually requires the certificate or delegation to name the seller or the billed entity.
- We accept unsigned electronic uploads through our portal (link below) or a signed PDF via reply; notarization rarely required unless state law asks for it.

Please upload the additional affidavit or the second entity certificate here: https://redwood-portal.company/uploads/ACME-23456 (or reply with attachments). Once uploaded I'll run intake and post a receipt. If you want, I can loop in Billing and Tax for TX-specific wording — I can do that after you upload the affidavit.

If you prefer a short call to align on language (one-pager), I'm available 1–3pm PT today.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Redwood | Billing Intake Portal: https://redwood-portal.company/docs/billing-evidence-guidance.pdf]

From: Emily Huang <emily.h@acme.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale coverage for split billing + multiple ship-to locations

Tessa — thanks, that helps. Attached are two documents per your checklist: a short supplementary affidavit listing the two ship-to addresses and a subsidiary EIN confirmation letter for Acme Ops LLC. We don't have a separate resale certificate for Acme Ops LLC yet; the affidavit is signed by our tax lead.

Attachments:
- acme_ops_suppl_affidavit.pdf (PDF, 48KB) — lists CA ship-to (123 Market St, San Francisco, CA) and TX ship-to (500 Commerce Dr, Austin, TX) and references Acme Holdings as primary exempt entity.
- acme_subsidiary_ein_letter.pdf (PDF, 22KB) — internal letter confirming EIN for Acme Ops LLC.

Would the affidavit + EIN letter be enough to clear CA invoices immediately and to provisionally clear TX while we obtain a separate certificate? If not, tell me the exact wording TX needs and we can get it today.

Emily
[Attachments: acme_ops_suppl_affidavit.pdf, acme_subsidiary_ein_letter.pdf]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Huang <emily.h@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Resale coverage for split billing + multiple ship-to locations

Emily — appreciate the quick turnaround and for attaching the affidavit + EIN letter. I've reviewed them with Billing and our tax lead (cc'd). Summary and next steps: 

- CA (123 Market St): Supplementary affidavit + blanket certificate is sufficient. We'll lift the invoice hold for CA invoices immediately after intake processing.
- TX (500 Commerce Dr): Because TX rules typically require the certificate to name the billed entity or a delegation, the affidavit alone is provisional. To fully clear TX invoices we need either: (1) a resale certificate that names Acme Ops LLC (preferred), or (2) a delegation letter on Acme Holdings letterhead explicitly authorizing Acme Holdings to purchase tax-exempt on behalf of Acme Ops LLC and listing the TX ship-to address.

If you can provide (1) or (2) later today, we can retroactively clear pending TX invoices back to the invoice date. Otherwise, TX invoices will remain on hold until we receive the documentation (we'll continue to provisionally review).

Action items for Acme:
- Upload the affidavit + EIN letter to the portal (you did — thanks) and also upload either the Acme Ops LLC resale cert or a delegation letter for TX. Portal link again: https://redwood-portal.company/uploads/ACME-23456
- If you prefer, I can accept a signed PDF by reply and route it to Tax.

I've created an intake receipt and put the record into our billing queue; intake receipt attached. Once the TX document is uploaded I'll mark the case resolved and send a confirmation email.

HubSpot reference: HS-23456 — I'll update the contact and note the intake.

Thanks again — looping Ben and Rishi for visibility on the invoice hold / retro clearance.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: intake_receipt_20270708.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]
